$comment: Required-cases manifest (plan §7.2). Maps the §9 acceptance scenarios (E01-E15) to the REAL Go test names that prove them. Consumed by scripts/acceptance/verify-tests.py --required-cases. A listed test that does not run, or that is skipped, is a hard failure. PARTIALLY FILLED (T18 local pre-flight, 2026-10-13): E02/E04/E05/E07/E09/E10/E11 are mapped to tests that were actually executed and passed locally. The remaining scenarios keep an empty array with a 'pending' reason; an empty array is NOT a claim that the scenario passes.

scenarios.summary: normal path: two Anvil chains emit ERC20 logs; one verified Swap fixture
scenarios.pending: needs two Anvil chains + fixture deploy (not runnable in this sandbox)

scenarios.note: covers the zero-log block and the all-duplicate block against a real Postgres; out-of-order arrival is covered by the digest order-independence tests, not by this case

scenarios.summary: fork depth 1/2/12; same-height new hash; tx re-included
scenarios.pending: needs Anvil to fork at depth 1/2/12

scenarios.summary: two-chain isolation: A rollback leaves B unchanged
commit-crash kill at boundaries + SIGTERM graceful shutdown
scenarios.note: covers the SIGTERM graceful-shutdown half; the commit-crash half is exercised by the atomic-rollback contract test in the contracts lane

scenarios.summary: repair-job crash: DB rollback done, notify fails, restart resumes
scenarios.pending: chaos lane not built; resume logic is unit-tested by TestRepairResumeRepairsEveryPendingJob in pkg/services/reorg, but that is not a crash rehearsal

scenarios.summary: finality failure: finalized/safe unavailable, stale, wrong chain

scenarios.pending: NOT IMPLEMENTED: no 429 / Retry-After handling exists anywhere in pkg/ (code or test) — this scenario cannot be mapped until it is written

scenarios.summary: DB/MQ/Redis failure: backpressure, redelivery, no early ack
scenarios.note: the MQ (Kafka) half is TestKafkaRedeliveryKeepsEffectSingle, which SKIPS because the broker's advertised listener is unreachable from this host; it is deliberately NOT listed, because a required skip is a failure

scenarios.summary: auth: nonce concurrency/expiry/address swap, bad origin/format
scenarios.note: the Redis-backed nonce tests (TestRedisNonceStoreTwoInstancesOneWinner) skip in -short mode and are not listed here

scenarios.summary: precision/decoding: signed/unsigned bounds, bad topics, unknown ABI
API compat + paging across cold/hot cache and reorg
scenarios.pending: needs the frontend build + a running API

scenarios.summary: mode equivalence: monolithic vs four-service canonical digest equal
